name: @emberchat/desktop
// packaging metadata: electron-builder reads these into the bundle: the description becomes the macOS bundle's and the installer's, the author the copyright holder. Kept here rather than in electron-builder.yml because they are facts about the package, and because productName already lives here (MX4, #305). productName is the one literal spelling of the product name in this app: Electron reads it from package.json before any code runs, and it must equal APP_NAME in @emberchat/protocol, which is the source of truth (#556).
description: A desktop client for F-Chat with its own built-in bouncer.
author: The EmberChat contributors

scripts.dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run server-runtime && electron .
